calculations.interpretation: The full-temperature threshold spread already exceeds the complete permitted current-setting error before shunt, layout, temperature, calibration residual, FET, fault and test terms. The 3.1 mV code step is also too coarse to be treated as a guaranteed 6.000-6.400 A trim by itself.

evidence: 2.9-33 V controller range covers the HPQ4 12 V source plane
12 V gate-drive class, foldback, I2C configuration, timer and fault telemetry

qualification_gates.requirement: Each of six loops guarantees 6.000-6.400 A over all component, supply, process and temperature tolerances.
qualification_gates.evidence_gap: No candidate supplies a manufacturer-guaranteed window; LTC4281/4282 threshold endpoints alone fail the complete budget.

qualification_gates.requirement: Limiter and associated sense path remain within 57 mOhm hot allocation.
qualification_gates.evidence_gap: Controller data sheets do not qualify the complete installed shunt, copper and pass-FET path; exact nFET hot gate-drive evidence is also open.

qualification_gates.requirement: 12 V source compatibility over 12.05-12.60 V sustained and 12.10-12.60 V peak.
qualification_gates.evidence_gap: LTC4281/4282 voltage class is compatible, but complete installed architecture and transient qualification remain open.

qualification_gates.requirement: Overcurrent, short-circuit, timer, retry/latch, reverse-current/reverse-polarity and surge behavior are bound with exact FET/fuse/TVS/harness values.
qualification_gates.evidence_gap: Manufacturer controller functions are documented, but no PiSXMe system waveform, reverse policy, clamp, SOA/I2t or six-loop fault truth table is qualified.

qualification_gates.requirement: Production trim/test can prove the post-calibration residual across temperature, retention and traceability.
qualification_gates.evidence_gap: LTC4281 text permits final-test trim, but no approved residual specification, test fixture, temperature corners, EEPROM/configuration retention or lot traceability exists.

qualification_gates.requirement: Exact package/footprint, procurement status, assembly and thermal installation are authoritative.
qualification_gates.evidence_gap: No selected production architecture or exact coordinated component set is approved; no CAD release authorized.

residual_dependency.condition: Qualify one exact production architecture with an explicit post-calibration and temperature-bound current window, or acquire manufacturer evidence for a part already guaranteed inside the window.
minimum_required_evidence: exact controller and all six-loop component MPNs/package/footprint provenance
full-tolerance and full-temperature current-limit calculation or manufacturer guarantee proving 6.000-6.400 A on every loop
calibration target, allowed residual, fixture accuracy, temperature corners, EEPROM/configuration retention and production traceability
complete hot limiter resistance including shunt, FET, copper and any sense interconnect <=57 mOhm
exact gate-drive minimum and hot RDS(on) qualification
fault timing, reverse-current/reverse-polarity, TVS clamp, fuse, harness inductance and nFET SOA/I2t coordination
six-loop fail-safe FLAG/inhibit/reset behavior and thermal/package installation qualification
residual_dependency.resume: After the authority records this evidence, requalify the exact nFET and protection assembly, then release the source contract and downstream CAD producer only through the normal serialized integration and fresh-Light validation path.
